# Dust — configuration reference

Every setting Dust has, with its default and when a change to it takes effect.

Settings are read from `dust.toml`, then overridden by environment variables
named `DUST__SECTION__FIELD` (two underscores between path segments, because one
is a legal character inside a setting name), then by runtime commands.

The **when** column says what a change does:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| `hot` | Takes effect on reload. |
| `hot, new chunks only` | Takes effect on reload, for terrain generated from then on. Chunks already on disk are not regenerated and do not change. |
| `restart` | Read once at startup. |

## `[server]`

Listener, identity and the basics a server needs to answer a ping.

| Setting | Type | Default | When | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bind` | `String` | `"0.0.0.0:25565"` | restart | Address to listen on, as `host:port`. |
| `motd` | `String` | `"A Dust server"` | hot | Message shown in the client's server list. |
| `max_players` | `u32` | `20` | hot | Maximum concurrent players. This is the number shown in the server list, not a licence — the gateway may admit more across several backends. |
| `online_mode` | `bool` | `true` | restart | Verify each joining player against Mojang's session servers. Turning this off means anyone may join under any name, and is only safe behind a proxy that does the check itself. |

## `[jvm]`

The embedded JVM that runs plugin bytecode.

| Setting | Type | Default | When | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `true` | restart | Start the embedded JVM and load plugins. With this off, Dust runs with no JVM in the process at all and everything except plugins still works. |
| `max_heap_mib` | `u32` | `1024` | restart | Heap ceiling for the embedded JVM, in mebibytes. |
